source_units.claim: Staying alive and avoiding ruin is the only thing that matters.
Embracing death on the gallows is necessary to awaken the nation.

gate_1_same_proposition.details: Both evaluate the ultimate priority of life preservation.

gate_2_same_definition.details: Both evaluate biological mortality vs continued existence.

gate_3_same_scope.details: Failed: Personal capital management vs anti-colonial liberation struggle.

gate_4_same_timeframe.details: Failed: 2020 post-industrial capital markets vs 1931 colonial India under martial decree.

gate_5_same_evidence_domain.details: Failed: Market volatility statistics vs political executions and martial law.

gate_6_same_level_of_analysis.details: Failed: Micro-individual behavior vs Macro-state transformation.

gate_7_same_genre_register.details: Failed: Analytical nonfiction vs Historical biography.

gate_8_same_attributor_category.details: Failed: Contemporary author heuristic vs Historical subject writing in condemned cell.

gate_10_mutually_exclusive_facts.details: Failed: Normative priorities, not mutually exclusive empirical facts.

rationale: Fails Gates 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, and 10. The disagreement is an irreconcilable ethical tension between bourgeois self-preservation and revolutionary martyrdom, not a factual contradiction.

source_units.claim: Freedom is the ability to do what you want with your daily calendar.
Freedom is the total abolition of imperialism and capitalism.

gate_1_same_proposition.details: Failed: Different predicates attached to lexical token "freedom".

gate_2_same_definition.details: Failed: Temporal schedule control vs collective political-economic emancipation.

rationale: Dissolved at Gate 2. The authors use the identical word "freedom" to denote completely distinct concepts (lexical polysemy).

source_units.claim: Aiming to be reasonable beats being strictly rational.
Reason is the supreme weapon that must challenge all blind belief.

gate_1_same_proposition.details: Failed: Pragmatic emotional heuristic vs militant materialist epistemological defense.

gate_2_same_definition.details: Failed: Spreadsheet optimization vs scientific materialist skepticism.

rationale: Dissolved at Gate 1 & 2. The works operate within completely orthogonal epistemic frameworks.

candidate_title: Personal Capital Accumulation vs Elimination of Private Wealth

source_units.claim: Growing wealth safely provides security and personal freedom.
Private capital concentration produces exploitation and must be abolished.

gate_1_same_proposition.details: Both evaluate the social desirability of private capital accumulation.

gate_2_same_definition.details: Both refer to monetary and capital assets.

gate_3_same_scope.details: Failed: Individual household allocation vs total sovereign socioeconomic order.

gate_4_same_timeframe.details: Capitalist property relations exist in both periods.

gate_6_same_level_of_analysis.details: Failed: Micro-economic behavior vs Macro-structural class struggle.

gate_10_mutually_exclusive_facts.details: Mutually exclusive normative goals for human society.

rationale: Fails Gates 3 and 6. While normative conclusions clash directly, Housel speaks strictly to micro-individual adaptation within an existing market system, whereas Bhagat Singh speaks to macro-revolutionary restructuring.

candidate_title: Nagasawa Elitism vs Housel Luck/Risk Primacy

source_units.claim: Nagasawa claims superior discipline entitles one to lord over others.
Luck and risk dwarf individual effort; humility is mandatory.

gate_1_same_proposition.details: Both evaluate individual control over life outcomes.

gate_3_same_scope.details: Failed: Fictional psychology vs analytical economic reality.

gate_7_same_genre_register.details: Failed: Literary fiction vs analytical essay.

gate_8_same_attributor_category.details: Failed: Fictional character dialogue vs nonfiction author argument.

rationale: Dissolved at Gate 7 and 8. A fictional character’s spoken worldview cannot form a factual or authorial contradiction with a nonfiction author’s thesis.

source_units.claim: Tail events drive everything; normal events do not determine outcomes.
The Saunders assassination acted as a decisive tipping point.

gate_1_same_proposition.details: Both examine non-linear impact of rare occurrences.

gate_3_same_scope.details: Financial distribution curves vs single historical political assassination.

rationale: Shares core logic regarding the disproportionate weight of outlier events, but differs in operational scope.

source_units.claim: Ronald Read lived a quiet frugal life.
Saunders shot by Colt and Mauser pistols.
Trial exhibits confirm ballistic match with recovered Colt pistol.

rationale: Evaluated empirical test confirming ballistic corroboration; no factual contradiction exists.
